title: Returning-Guest Uplift on Travel-Issue Refunds (Loyalty Q&A)
content:
# Returning-guest uplift on a travel-issue nightly refund — loyalty Q&A

**The rule.** Guests who keep coming back get a loyalty uplift on the share of each affected night refunded on an approved travel issue on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, counted from the credits their Roamhaven Rewards ledger shows earned on completed stays in the last 24 calendar months: two or more such earnings add 10 percentage points; exactly one adds 5 percentage points; none adds nothing. With any uplift added, the share never exceeds 100 percent.

**What is counted?**
Each credit-earning entry in the guest's Roamhaven Rewards ledger posted in the last 24 calendar months — the credits earned on completed stays.

**How large is the uplift?**

| Earnings in the last 24 calendar months | Uplift |
|---|---|
| none | 0 points |
| exactly 1 | 5 percentage points |
| 2 | 10 percentage points |
| 3 or more | 10 percentage points |

**Worked: a 25 percent share with two earnings on record.**
The share becomes 35 percent.

**Worked: a 100 percent share with one earning on record.**
The share stays at 100 percent; it never exceeds 100.

**Worked: a 95 percent share with two earnings on record.**
95 plus 10 would be 105; the share is held at 100 percent.
